## What's fixed

- **Found why the music stops in the background.** Kultr's playback log showed that iOS closed Kultr for using too much processor time. iOS allows a background app about 80% of one core for a minute, and Kultr went over that just as an InjeKt mix began.
- **Less work in the background.** While Kultr isn't on screen, it no longer reads the playback position five times a second or redraws the animated progress bar. Those were the two things I could find that kept running for nothing.

That may not account for all of the processor time, so this version also measures it:

- **Processor use in the playback log.** Every 30 seconds in the background, Kultr checks how much of the processor it's using. When that reaches 40% of a core, it logs which threads are using it. The five-minute background status line now includes processor use as well.
- **Full detail in iOS's reports.** When iOS closes Kultr for using too much processor time or memory, its report pinpoints the exact code that was running. The log now shows that in full. Reports iOS sent to earlier versions are written again with the full detail, if iOS still has them.

If the music still stops, send me the playback log again. It should now show exactly what used the processor time.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
